plotEn:
In Brisbane, Australia former Army Special Forces operative Hank Malone works as a "runner", who transports legal and illegal items for clients. After acquiring an exotic parrot from a job gone wrong, Hank is contacted by his boss, Iggy, who instructs him to transport a package from an airport. At the airport, Hank meets Ben Bishop. On Ben's insistence, Hank takes him and the package—a transplant liver—to a hospital.
On the way to the hospital, Hank calls Iggy. Hank ignores Iggy's fearful demands that the liver be taken straight to the drop-off point. Realizing they have been followed, Hank questions Ben, and Ben reveals that the liver's donor and recipient both have Rh Null, an extremely rare blood type. Hank asks how the organ was obtained, and Ben replies that it is from a victim of the Colombian cartel. The two are chased by cartel members, who are in pursuit of the liver. After a series of vehicular chases, Iggy calls Hank to beg for the liver. Hank refuses, as the liver is intended for a young girl named Ellie, and the cartel kills Iggy. During the chase to escape, Hank's car is destroyed.
Hank and Ben escape the cartel and go to the house of Hank's ex-wife, Monica. Monica gives them a bike to get to her car, and Hank gives Monica the exotic parrot as thanks. While biking to the car, Hank reveals that he is a recovering alcoholic whose marriage to Monica ended after their daughter, Isabel, died of leukemia.
